purpose: Post-release recheck of two tools of the frozen review-history benchmark at their new releases. Not part of the frozen evaluation: no protocol, task, source, oracle, adapter, runner, capture or amendment of evidence/review-history-benchmark changes, and verify() must pass before every capture.

run.flags: docker run --rm --network none --user 65534:65534 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges -e HOME=/tmp, source read-only and an output folder mounted (the frozen adapters' SANDBOX)
run.adapters: research/review_history_adapters.py and the runners it copies into the container (research/review_history_runners/docx_cli.mjs, research/review_history_adeu.py), unchanged and still pinned by the frozen protocol; research/review_history_recheck.py only points them at the image named here
run.network: only while building the image (base image pull, uv and the locked wheels for adeu); none for any attempt

upstream_changes.#14: decode numeric character references instead of re-escaping them (issue #12, reported from this benchmark)
upstream_changes.#18: warn when a whole-paragraph edit resolves other authors' revisions
upstream_changes.#19: hide a revision nested inside a hidden one in the accepted/baseline views (issue #13)
upstream_changes.#20: a tracked span inside another author's insertion splits it Word-style (issue #13, reported from this benchmark)

upstream_changes.#21: an untracked replace cuts another author's insertion in place, nested wrappers included, instead of splitting it (issue #16, and issue #22, reported from this recheck)
upstream_changes.#25: one length grammar for every size flag

releases.package: adeu 3.0.7, built from the tag's python/ directory with its uv.lock (PyPI wheel adeu-3.0.7-py3-none-any.whl, sha256 adafe6e4076bf70fedadc397043ff1ceaea12238792c993abc2635b6b459f8bd, is the same release)

upstream_changes.#157: preserve tab elements across run splits
upstream_changes.#158: restore the paragraph break when rejecting a paragraph-mark deletion
upstream_changes.#159: date comments from the engine timestamp
upstream_changes.#156, #161: tests: shared scenario outputs checked with ooxml-integrity

build: mkdir -p tmp/recheck/adeu-build && git -C tmp/recheck/adeu-repo archive --prefix=adeu-src/ v3.0.7:python | tar -x -C tmp/recheck/adeu-build
releases.reports: adeu 3.0.7, python-docx 1.2.0, lxml 6.1.1 (importlib.metadata inside the image)
